item.title: 34 years of stitching luck: how a Houston seamstress keeps Lunar New Year traditions alive
item.description: Lin Lin Huang, a Houston seamstress, has been handcrafting custom garments for families celebrating Lunar New Year for 34 years, keeping the Chinese culture alive and helping generations step into the holiday dressed in meaning, culture, and pride.

item.title: Freed slave who built Houston: The Powerful Legacy of Antioch Missionary Baptist Church
item.description: Antioch Missionary Baptist Church, founded in 1866 by newly freed black men and women, has been a foundation for Houston's Black community, providing a spiritual home, advocating for justice, and helping to lay the groundwork for the city's Black middle class and civic structure.

item.title: Man charged with capital murder after deadly shooting in northwest Houston
item.description: A 21-year-old man has been charged with capital murder after a deadly shooting in northwest Houston. The victim was identified as Fernando Gallardo.

item.title: Plan ahead: Early voting in Harris County from Feb. 17-27
item.description: Find out everything you need to know about early voting for the March primary election in Harris County, Texas. Don't miss out on your chance to vote!

item.title: Man shot while confronting car thieves in west Houston, HCSO says
item.description: Detectives are investigating a shooting of a man after seeing a group allegedly attempting to break into cars at a west Houston apartment complex.

item.title: Precinct 4 constables searching for missing elderly woman in Cypress
item.description: Harris County authorities are searching for a missing 77-year-old woman from Cypress who is believed to be in the early stages of dementia.

item.title: Actor Robert Duvall dies at 95, wife announces
item.description: He died "peacefully at home, surrounded by love and comfort."

item.title: Nancy Guthrie family cleared by investigators
item.description: All family members and spouses have been cleared in the alleged abduction of Nancy Guthrie, officials said Monday.

item.title: 2 killed, 3 injured in Rhode Island ice rink shooting
item.description: Three people are dead, including the suspect, and three others are in critical condition after a shooting at a Rhode Island ice skating rink Monday afternoon.

item.title: Harris County demolishes dangerous abandoned hotel
item.description: An abandoned hotel in Channelview, a 'dangerous nuisance property,' was demolished after catching fire seven times in a year.
